fields.description: Reported study design; do not infer randomization.
Reported sample size with units and analysis population; preserve source wording.
Country, institution or other reported study context.
Reported intervention, comparators, measurements and procedures.
Reported variables, outcomes and measurement scales.
Findings as reported, distinguishing association from causation.
Limitations explicitly reported by the source.
Reported effect size, units, uncertainty interval and adjustment status; no calculation or invented values.

appraisal.description: Illustrative domain questions only. This is not a validated risk-of-bias instrument; choose an appropriate framework for the review before real use. No aggregate score is produced.

domains.description: Is participant selection described sufficiently for the intended review?
Are outcomes and measurement procedures described sufficiently?
Are results, uncertainty and limitations described sufficiently?
